WHATSAPP.TITLE: WhatsApp
WHATSAPP.DESCRIPTION: Connect and manage your WhatsApp numbers without technical setup.

LIST.TITLE: WhatsApp connections

WIZARD.TITLE: Connect WhatsApp number
WIZARD.SCAN_DESCRIPTION: Open WhatsApp on your phone, go to Linked devices and scan this code.

WIZARD.SUCCESS_DESCRIPTION: Your number is ready to receive conversations.

ACTIONS.DELETE_MODAL_BODY: This will remove the managed connection "{name}", its configuration, and the associated instance. Existing conversations follow Chatwoot inbox deletion policy.
ACTIONS.CONFIRM_DISCONNECT: Disconnect WhatsApp? This closes the WhatsApp session but keeps the inbox and its configuration.
ACTIONS.CONFIRM_DEACTIVATE: Deactivate this connection? Monitoring and automatic inbox recreation will stop. You can restore it later.
ACTIONS.CONFIRM_RECONNECT: This will generate a new QR code. Continue?
ACTIONS.DISCONNECT_HELP: Closes the WhatsApp session, but keeps the inbox and its configuration.
ACTIONS.DEACTIVATE_HELP: Stops the connection and prevents automatic recreation. It can be restored.
ACTIONS.DELETE_HELP: Removes the managed connection, its configuration, and the associated instance. Existing conversations follow Chatwoot inbox deletion policy.
